TLOU2 Campaign Co-op - test build (M3.6)
Fan project, built on the Twelve Weeks client (GPL-3.0). Needs The Last of Us Part II Remastered on Steam.

INSTALL
1. Close the game.
2. Open the game folder: Steam > Library > right-click The Last of Us Part II > Manage > Browse local files.
3. If a winmm.dll is already there (for example from Twelve Weeks), rename it to winmm.dll.bak.
4. Copy winmm.dll and tlou2-coop.ini from this zip into that folder.
5. Start the game from Steam (not from the Twelve Weeks launcher).

PLAY
- Both players must be Steam friends.
- Host: load into the campaign, then press F7.
- Friend: press F8 - even on the main menu. The game loads into the host's chapter and puts you
  next to the host. If the host moves to a new part of the story, you follow automatically.
  If you reach the next chapter before the host, you wait there up to 25 seconds for the host;
  if the host does not come, you are taken back to the host.
- F6 leaves. The status line in the top-left corner shows what is happening.
- No port forwarding, no IP addresses, no extra programs (it uses Steam's own networking).
- While you are joined to someone else's game, your game does not save (your own progress is safe).
- Deaths: if the host dies or reloads, the joined player reloads with them. The joined player
  does not die from damage: a killing hit respawns them next to the host at full health instead,
  so their game stays in sync (no checkpoint reload).

WHAT WORKS IN THIS TEST
- You see your partner as a character that copies their movement, animation and weapon.
- Gunshots: you see and hear your partner's shots (muzzle flash, sound, arrows).
- Name tags: your partner's name is shown above their character (nametags=0 in tlou2-coop.ini hides it).
- Difficulty: the joined player plays on the host's difficulty; their own is restored when they leave.
- Shared enemies: the host's game runs the enemies. In the joining player's game the same
  enemies follow the host's positions, and damage and kills from either player apply to both.
  They walk, run and turn with their own animations and fire when the host's enemies fire.
- Joining late: enemies the host already killed are removed, and enemies that appeared later
  for the host are added, so both players face the same enemies.
- Doors and pickups: a door one player opens opens for both, an item one player picks up
  disappears for the other (also for a player who joins late). If the host dies or reloads,
  items picked up since the checkpoint come back for both.
- Enemies see and attack both players; their hits on your partner's character hurt your partner.
- Friendly fire is off: your bullets do not hurt your partner. The host can turn it on with
  friendlyfire=1 in tlou2-coop.ini (the host's setting counts for both players).
  This covers bullets only so far: arrows, explosions and melee can still hurt your partner.
- Not shared yet: cutscenes.
- Both players need this same build (older builds refuse to connect).

UNINSTALL
Delete winmm.dll and tlou2-coop.ini (rename winmm.dll.bak back if you had one).

If something goes wrong, send tlou2-coop.log from the game folder.
